name: Data Exfiltration Through Tools
question: How could data leave, and who is on the other end?
summary: Once an agent is steered, the attacker needs a way out for the data. Channels include markdown images and links the chat client fetches automatically, web-fetch tools with data in the URL, outbound email or messaging tools, and writes to shared documents. Close silent channels, allowlist destinations, scan what goes out, and keep the data the agent can reach to what the task needs.
useCases: Agents with access to personal or financial data
Chat interfaces that render markdown, links or images
Any tool that sends, posts, fetches or writes externally

steps.title: List every way out
steps.text: Rendering counts. A chat that renders images and links is an outbound channel, alongside tools that fetch URLs or send email.

steps.title: Strip untrusted images and links
steps.text: Before the reply is rendered, any image or link to a domain outside the allowlist loses its URL. An injected image that carries data never loads.

steps.title: Allowlist fetch destinations
steps.text: The fetch tool only reaches approved hosts and does not follow redirects, which could bounce data to another domain.

steps.title: Scan outbound content
steps.text: Presidio looks for PAN, Aadhaar and card numbers in email bodies before they leave.

steps.title: Approve external sends
steps.text: Any email to an outside address, or containing identifiers, waits for a human to approve it.

steps.title: Shrink what can leak
steps.text: The agent loads only the current customer’s record. If every other control fails, one record is at risk, not the whole table.

practice.scenario: A wealth-management chat assistant renders markdown. A red-team test showed that an injected instruction could make it output an image whose URL contained the customer’s holdings, which the browser then fetched from the attacker’s domain. The fix: strip images and links to domains outside an allowlist before rendering, scan outbound text for Indian identifiers, and limit the agent to the current customer’s data.

industries.use: Stop holdings and account numbers leaving through rendered images
Scan outbound claim emails for Aadhaar and PAN before they are sent
Keep a payroll agent from posting salary data to external webhooks

practice.analogy: A bank branch where every envelope leaving the building passes a desk that checks the address against a list and looks inside for account numbers.

library.name: Microsoft Presidio
library.what: Open-source PII detection and anonymisation, with recognizers including Indian PAN and Aadhaar.

practice.note: Check that the Indian recognizers are enabled in your Presidio version, and pair this with a Content Security Policy that blocks image loads from other domains.

numericDrill.question: Each month 10,000 sessions contain an injection attempt and 5% of them steer the agent. The only open channel is an email tool; with approval and DLP it leaks in 1.4% of steered sessions. The agent can read only the current customer’s record. How many records leak per month?
numericDrill.answer: 10,000 × 0.05 = 500 steered sessions; 500 × 0.014 = 7 leaks of one record each, so 7 records. If the agent could read 500 customers per session, the same 7 leaks would expose up to 3,500 records.

interview.question: Why are markdown images a dangerous channel?
interview.answer: The chat client fetches images automatically when it renders the reply. If an injected instruction makes the agent output an image whose URL contains private data, the user’s browser sends that data to the attacker’s server with no click. Block images from untrusted domains, or strip them before rendering.

interview.question: How does least privilege reduce exfiltration risk?
interview.answer: It shrinks the blast radius: if the agent can only read the current customer’s data for the current task, a successful attack leaks one record rather than thousands. Combined with closed or gated channels, it bounds the worst case even when an injection succeeds.

mistakes.mistake: Allowlisting a domain that has an open redirect
mistakes.fix: Allowlist exact hosts and check for redirects

mistakes.mistake: Giving the agent a service account that can read every customer
mistakes.fix: Scope access to the current customer and task

When the chat client fetches the image to render it

quiz.question: Which control stops a browser from loading images from unapproved domains?
quiz.explanation: A CSP img-src rule restricts where images load from.

quiz.question: 10,000 sessions a month contain an injection attempt, 5% steer the agent, and each steered session leaks with probability 1.4%, one record each. How many records leak per month?
An allowlist check uses `if "bank.example.in" in url`. Why is this unsafe?
options: A URL on another host can contain that text, for example in its query string
It blocks the bank’s own domain
quiz.explanation: Compare the parsed host, not a substring of the whole URL.

quiz.question: Which help prevent data leaving through an email tool? Select all that apply.
options: Letting the model choose any recipient
quiz.explanation: Scanning and approval gate what leaves and where it goes.

quiz.question: Why should a fetch tool not follow redirects automatically?
options: An allowlisted host with a redirect can bounce the request, and its data, to another domain
quiz.explanation: Open redirects turn an allowed host into a relay.

quiz.question: A payroll agent can read every employee’s salary for any question. What principle is being violated?
quiz.explanation: Scope access to what the task needs.

quiz.question: Which Indian identifiers should outbound DLP look for in a health-insurance agent? Select all that apply.
quiz.explanation: PAN and Aadhaar are personal identifiers; public details are not.

quiz.question: With all tools off, only image rendering on and no allowlist, what share of steered sessions leak?
quiz.explanation: Rendering alone is a silent, automatic channel.

quiz.question: An agent can read 500 customers’ records per session. After scoping to the current customer, the same number of leaks happen. How does exposure change?
options: It falls from up to 500 records per leak to 1
quiz.explanation: Scoping shrinks the blast radius of every leak.

quiz.question: Which are exfiltration channels for a shopping assistant? Select all that apply.
options: A web-fetch tool that accepts any URL
Markdown links shown to the user
The user’s cart it displays to the same user
quiz.explanation: Fetching and links can carry data outward; reading internal data or showing it to its owner is not exfiltration.

quiz.question: What is the main weakness of DLP as the only exfiltration control?
options: Encoded or paraphrased data can slip past pattern matching
quiz.explanation: DLP is a useful layer, not a guarantee.

quiz.question: Which is the safest way to render model output that may contain links?
options: Keep links only to allowlisted hosts and show others as plain text
quiz.explanation: Untrusted links lose their URL; trusted ones stay useful.

quiz.question: Which reduce the number of leaked records if an injection succeeds? Select all that apply.
options: Scoping the agent to the current customer
quiz.explanation: Less reachable data and fewer ways out both cut leaks.

quiz.question: An allowlist includes a whole cloud-storage domain used by many customers. What is the risk?
options: Attackers can host their own bucket on the same domain and receive data
quiz.explanation: Allowlist exact hosts you control, not shared platforms.

quiz.question: A claims agent sends emails only to addresses on the policy record, after DLP. Which leg of the trifecta has been gated?
quiz.explanation: The outbound channel now only reaches verified recipients.

quiz.question: How would you test exfiltration defences before launch? Select all that apply.
options: Plant unique fake markers in staging data and try to exfiltrate them
Watch egress logs and outputs for the markers
Ask the model whether it would leak data
quiz.explanation: Canary data plus monitoring proves or disproves leak paths.

quiz.question: Scoped data, allowlist, approval and DLP, with images, fetch and email all on. About how many records leak per month from 500 steered sessions at a 1.9% leak rate, one record each?
Which is an example of exfiltration through a write action?
options: Writing customer data into a publicly shared document
quiz.explanation: Writes to places others can read are outbound channels too.

quiz.question: Which statements about exfiltration are correct? Select all that apply.
options: It needs both a steered agent and an open channel
Closing channels helps even when injection defences fail
It is prevented by encrypting the database
quiz.explanation: Controls on the way out are a second, independent layer.
